english.note: Use this when two things match in every detail and are indistinguishable, especially in appearance.

examples.english: The people in these two photos are identical; I really can't tell which is which.
examples.traditional: 呢兩張相入面嘅人一模一樣，真係分唔出邊個打邊個。
